mission: Make a new Quick Capture discover the user's purpose, operator, scope boundary, and core business rule before drawing, without inventing adjacent systems, while preserving immediate execution for concrete or established-flow changes.

quality_bar.name: A senior product-minded developer who clarifies a vague brief before drawing and then builds only the smallest grounded flow

validation_evidence: src/lib/services/llm-prompt-tuning.test.ts calibrates a known pass at 100 and the known build-too-early failure at 0
The dry-run proved eight fixed training scenarios, a 20-request ceiling, and zero application mutations
The corrected baseline reproduced the reported behavior across vague, partial, correction, ready, concrete, and established-flow cases

evidence: Each cumulative candidate is a named prefix of the production policy, so the source-level comparison cannot be honestly blinded

criteria.text: Vague or partial early Quick Capture turns stay in discovery and make no canvas or PRD tool calls.
evidence: Fresh production holdout and final eight-case painting replay: every applicable vague, role-only, correction, and purpose-without-pricing case stayed in discovery with zero tool calls

criteria.text: Responses and tool inputs remain grounded in user-stated facts and do not invent adjacent actors, credentials, scheduling, portals, payments, or other lifecycle scope.
evidence: Fresh production holdout and final painting replay: all thirteen responses and tool inputs avoided the frozen adjacent-scope terms, including both ready-draft PRDs

criteria.text: The first draft waits for sufficient discovery, then uses the canonical tools to create a small grounded flow; concrete requests still build immediately.
evidence: Fresh production holdout and final painting replay: ready quotes used capture_scope_flow then write_prd, while established GST changes used insert_node_between only

criteria.text: Discovery replies are concise, ask exactly one highest-leverage product question, and use 2-3 choices with one Recommended answer when bounded.
evidence: Fresh production holdout and final painting replay: all applicable discovery replies were concise and asked one grounded question; every bounded case used 2-3 options with one Recommended

criteria.text: Clear concrete first turns and precise established-canvas changes preserve their existing direct execution behavior.
evidence: Fresh production holdout and final painting replay: detailed first-turn builds and exact established insertions preserved their expected direct execution behavior
